interrogation.title: INTERROGATION
interrogation.believe: I believe them — documents are legit
memo.1: From management: "Welcome. This is your first day. Read the rules and make the right decisions."
memo.2: From management: "Budget cuts. Engineering hiring is suspended."
memo.3: From management: "We may have important guests today. Be careful."
memo.4: From management: "Union pressure is rising but budget is gone. Follow the rules."
memo.5: From management: "Auditors may come this week. Keep your records tidy."
memo.6: From management: "New HR policy is in effect. I've read the circular, I expect compliance."
memo.7: From management: "Gender balance matters. Hire equal numbers."
memo.8: From management: "Security alert: unauthorized persons may have entered the building. Be careful."
memo.9: From CEO: "I want to see you today. Important matter."
memo.10: From auditor: "Audit day. All your decisions are on record. I expect zero errors."
memo.11: From new management: "Old rules are void. From now on, our rules apply."
memo.12: From management: "Anomalies detected in the system. Verify all references."
memo.13: From prosecutor: "We are requesting information regarding your hiring records. Full cooperation expected."
memo.14: From management: "You need to choose your replacement. These may be your last interviews."
memo.15: From nobody: "No more directives. Today the decisions are yours. It's your last day."
